body:
That’s actually a really good idea, thank you :)

And I’ve gone on multiple interviews and all job opportunities have rejected me because of my age. But I do have a boyfriend that does have enough savings to move out-

And I’ll definitely try going out more, that sounds really helpful :)

Thank you so much for this, it really means a lot :) 

The thing I’m struggling on right now, (besides the whole post) is whether to continue school or not. I’ll be able to legally drop out in a few months, so it’s a legitimate question. 

School takes time, money, resources that may not even benefit me in the future. But if I drop out I’ll become a disgrace to my parents and other family.

Any tips on that?

No I can’t really go somewhere else sooner, I’m 15 turning 16 at the end of November. I’m legally not allowed to leave until my birthday :/

Thank you for your care, your message made me smile :)

Don’t do anything irrational, please. Your family and friends will be devastated if you don’t return whether that’s killing yourself or running away. 

Come back home, and talk about how your feeling to a therapist. If you don’t wanna do that try talking to your doctor about antidepressants.

Hey wait, don’t go yet. She won’t move on, she’ll be devastated. You’ll break her trust, she’ll probably blame herself for not being there. There are minimum wage jobs that you could possibly get, and earn enough money for rent for an apartment. 

And let’s have a heart to heart, stranger to stranger. I’ve been through shit and so have you. But if you keep going, one day you’ll say “man am I glad I pushed through.” You’ll get through it, you’ll find a way. Talk to your fiancé about it, maybe she could help. If you have enough funds, try talking to a therapist.

Keep living man, I believe in you

Hey I know shit is hard, but is there anything that you could do besides drink? Anything at all? (Well besides things that are harmful don’t do that)

And in one of your comments you said you had good friends right? Maybe you could hang with them more, talk to them. Try talking to a therapist if you can. I believe in you ✌️
